test_coverage_notes: TxMeta is a core protocol class, so it is likely tested in protocol-level and transaction-processing tests. Look for tests in files like 'test/TxMeta_test.cpp', 'test/Transaction_test.cpp', or integration tests that exercise transaction application and metadata. However, direct validation of error paths (e.g., failed dynamic_cast, missing fields) may not be fully covered unless there are explicit negative tests. Template-based validation and XRPL_ASSERTs may not be directly tested unless assertions are enabled in test builds. There may be gaps in coverage for malformed or incomplete STObject/Blob inputs.
